parameters.name: beginTime
parameters.description: The start timestamp of the log, in milliseconds. The value must be within the last 7 days. If this parameter is not specified, all logs within the range of \[current time - 7 days, endTime\] are queried.

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: The end timestamp of the log, in milliseconds. The value must be within the last 7 days. Specify this parameter. If this parameter is not specified, an empty result is returned.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page number of the plugin list. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Default value: 20. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 50.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description:
The log type. Valid values:
- INSTANCELOG: primary log.
- SEARCHSLOW: searching slow log.
- INDEXINGSLOW: indexing slow log.
- JVMLOG: GC log.
- ES_SEARCH_ACCESS_LOG: Elasticsearch access log.
- AUDIT: audit log.

For limits on viewing logs, see [Query logs](~~72026~~).
